title: surea11y-lab comparison
description: comparison.json in a downloaded comparison zip: how the reports beside it, in reports/, are arranged. Generated from src/shared/report-schemas.js by `npm run build:action-docs`; do not edit the file in schemas/ by hand.

context.description: What the reports are: runs over time, versions of a site, or variants of a page.

order.description: Whether the columns follow the runs' time, or the order given here.

profilesOff.description: The profiles turned off, so the comparison is read on the others: "wcag" for WCAG at any level, else a profile's id. Absent when every profile the reports share is compared.

reports.description: The reports in column order, each a file in the zip.
